title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1, and the honesty message (the problem is open) must be clear.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a plain-language glossary page about the known results
body:
## Problem
Names such as Leray, Ladyzhenskaya, Kato, Beale-Kato-Majda, Prodi-Serrin and Caffarelli-Kohn-Nirenberg appear without a one-page summary.

## Context
Students need a short, careful map of what is known and what is open.

## Expected outcome
A short page, in your own words, listing each result and its status, with sources you actually read.

## Relevant files
`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `sessions/session-03/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every claim marked as proved, numerical evidence or open
- [ ] No claim that the Millennium problem is solved

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: a 3-D pseudo-spectral solver
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The repo only evaluates the 3-D stretching term on a given field.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Higher-precision Cole-Hopf for small viscosity
body:
## Problem
The exact Burgers solution in double precision fails at nu = 0.02 and below.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 4; extended precision (for example the mpmath package, or exact scaling of the series) can repair it.

## Expected outcome
A function that matches a converged N = 2048 run to 1e-6 at nu = 0.01, t = 1.5.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Agreement to 1e-6
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a resolution study of the Burgers front
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows the peak gradient at several resolutions; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation and an animation like the Target, with a short honest write-up of what it does and does not show.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Peak gradients at N = 32, 64 and 512 for nu = 0.02 reproduce 8.0, 13.6 and 23.3
- [ ] Write-up states that the 3-D problem is open

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
